programme.title: Cheeni Kum
programme.desc: Buddhadev Gupta, a 64-year-old chef, falls in love with a 34-year-old software engineer, Nina. However, their future becomes uncertain when he discovers that her father is six years his junior.

programme.title: Aattral
programme.desc: Arjun's father, who is a mechanic, manages to get INR 10 lakh to fulfil Arjun's dream of developing an automatic car. However, the former is robbed and killed by a mysterious man.

programme.title: Traffic Signal
programme.desc: Silsila works as a loyal subordinate to a don, but complications arise when he unwittingly becomes a pawn in his boss's evil plan.

programme.title: Krishna Sudama
programme.desc: Sudama, Lord Krishna's childhood friend, is very poor. After a gap of many years, Sudama wants to meet Lord Krishna but faces many obstacles in reuniting with his friend.

programme.title: Awarapan
programme.desc: A hitman sets out to rescue his boss's mistress and send her back to her boyfriend after learning that she is a victim of sex trafficking.

programme.title: Chennai vs China
programme.desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

programme.title: Baby John
programme.desc: An indomitable policeman goes to greater lengths and leads a double life in order to protect his daughter from the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Geetha Govindam
programme.desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: Rajiv grows envious of his childhood friend, Chozhan, as he is better than him at most things. The frenemies grow apart only to meet under very different circumstances several years later.

programme.title: Mr. India
programme.desc: Hoping to make the world a better place for orphaned children, a compassionate street musician takes on a power-hungry crime boss with the help of a cloaking device.

programme.title: Jaws the Revenge
programme.desc: After losing her son to a shark, Ellen Brody moves to the Bahamas only to discover the deadly creature has followed her, threatening her family once more.

programme.title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd.
programme.desc: While on their honeymoon, six newly married couples discover hidden facets and unravel secrets about their respective spouses on their four-day journey to Goa.

programme.title: Farrey
programme.desc: Brought up in an orphanage, child prodigy Niyati gets admitted into a prestigious school. Soon, surrounded by money, she gets engulfed in a cheating racket.

programme.title: Good Boy, Bad Boy
programme.desc: Two students with similar names but wildly different personalities end up switching their classes in college when the administration mistakenly switches their identity cards.
